releaseDate.description: Release date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM

anyOf.description: Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.

value.description: JSON value attached to the session's instructions

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.

SessionsCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

started.description: Start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.
info.title: opencode HttpApi

get.description: Subscribe to native events and plugin RPC events across all server locations. Volatile by contract: a slow consumer overflows and fails the stream, and events during disconnection are missed.

schema.description: Only send events of these types, plus the initial server.connected event. When omitted, all events are sent.

get.description: Return the server identity, connection URLs, paths, and readiness status.
Retrieve the current snapshot of available models of the requested types, chat by default, ordered by release date within each type. The snapshot may precede initial plugin settlement.

schema.description: Only list models of these types. Defaults to chat, the only type offered for sessions.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.
Filter by parent session. Use null to return only root sessions.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location. A parentID creates a linked child session at its parent's location.

get.description: Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this OpenCode process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.

put.description: Replace the process environment used by local shell commands for this session.

get.description: Retrieve pending forms for a session.

delete.description: Cancel a pending form, optionally telling the asker why it was not answered.

get.description: List durable enqueued session work not yet delivered, ordered by enqueue sequence. Includes user, synthetic, compaction, and move items.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session, optionally filtered by type. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline, passing the same type filter on each page.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.
Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.
Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.

post.description: Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
